Policy: exact declared pack sizes (0.1% rounding only), explicit count or multipack proof for count items, vendor _KG IDs as evidence of loose per-weight produce. Missing/error sizes are unverified, not safe inclusions. Generic catalogue items are interpreted as conventional, unflavoured staples; organic, enhanced, light and distinctly prepared substitutes are separated. Brand-neutral catalogue items can accept multiple conventional brands.

Assignments below are positive audited identities and pass the supplied baseline matcher. Exclusions override all matches. Assignment compatibility with the other agent's revised strict matcher remains to be checked.

Interpretive limit: the catalogue has no explicit organic/brand metadata. Conventional-only, exact-size and unflavoured treatment is an audit policy, not retailer verification. Generic milk-alternative sweetening, generic tuna cut/species, generic cottage-cheese fat levels and generic pear/mango varieties are unspecified by catalogue and accepted if identity/size are clear. Red and white kidney beans are both legitimate under the generic kidney-beans item. Exclusions include unverifiable candidates and are not a claim the retailer product itself is bad.
